## Only for policy, SOP, or docs changes (anything under `apps/docs`)

Document(s) affected:

- [ ] Version number, approval, and revision history are updated
- [ ] New SOP added to its folder's `_meta.js` and to the SOP Library page
- [ ] No `[TBC]` remains in an SOP I am asking to have approved
- [ ] I checked the Vercel preview link
- [ ] I worked through the [Before you publish](https://github.com/grantmx/grithub/blob/main/apps/docs/content/contributing/before-you-publish.md) checklist: no personal information, no secrets, no internal-only links, no partner or funder names without permission, nothing identifying a child, and I have the right to share everything here
- [ ] If this changes a **policy**: the approval authority named in the policy has approved it
